dataset_name: Precast concrete elements for walls, pillars and beams (Based on the concrete recipe type 44)
category: 'Mineral building products' / 'Bricks, blocks and elements' / 'Precast concrete elements and goods'
Use advice for data set: The products are prefabricated elements for building, civil engineering and bridge construction, balconies, solid ceilings.
Technical purpose of product or process: The products are prefabricated elements for building, civil engineering and bridge construction, balconies, solid ceilings.
General comment on data set: The average EPD (type: Cradle to gate with modules C1–C4 and module D) is about custom made precast concrete based on the concrete recipe type 44 manufactured in Xanten, Germany. The calculation is based on 1 m³ of concrete with a share of 6 m% reinforcing and prestressed steel. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts shall not be liable with respect to manufacturer information, life cycle assessment data and evidences.
Technology description including backgro: The products are reinforced and prestressed precast concrete elements in various formats, sizes and applications. The elements are used as columns, walls and beams. The concrete type 44 has compressive strength class of C 55/67. The manufacturing contains the following processes: Delivery of raw materials; Preparation of the moulds (formwork, cutting and laying of the probation steel elements, placeholders); Concrete mixing and filling into the mould, curing; Removal of the formwork, finishing, storage
